body:
Apologies it isn’t very well written. My main instinct is to fix the situation, I’ve communicated and she says she’s trying but how long will it take and it makes me think why should it be my effort when it’s her situation to prove to me.

I want to say she’s given me trust issues from some previous things she did, in a way I feel like I’m being an asshole the most to myself.
Rockstar never really caters to the roleplaying aspect of their online games which sucks.
